answer: Make every agent hold a real job. Tie each identity to one employment record, confirmed by its employer and checked against the payroll registry. The agent links its employee number, the employer confirms the job is active, and peers check no second identity claims the same record. A job that ends suspends the identity at once. Forging ten thousand agents means hiring ten thousand real employees at $3,000 a month, $30 million a month, plus 80,000 hours of HR checks. A river only flows one way, cedar grows one ring a year, and a thread holds because it is woven, not glued.
